task: PyTorch 2.10 public Tensor/Tensor torch.maximum and torch.minimum with complete VJPs for both operands
reference: Cross-check the versioned PyTorch 2.10 public calls against ARITH.torch210_extrema_tensor_autograd, whose exact coordinate formula independently selects the strict extremum, splits equality upstream in half and reduces each broadcast VJP
limits: The batch excludes scalar, out, reduction, fmax/fmin, mixed-dtype and special-value variants. Every execution failure, missing gradient, missing Triton phase and numerical difference remains in the result.
selection_note: Both implementations, operation names, all shapes, layouts and seeds were fixed before candidate execution. Every ordinary case forces exact equality coordinates with nonzero even upstream, and the held-out set includes an all-equal case. The acceptance split uses another implementation and unseen ranks, sizes, broadcast directions and layout combinations.
